title: time until I ask for help
caption:
five hours of stubbornness, one minute of help.

0:05: "I got this." 0:45: reading the library's source.
2:00: it's personal now. 4:00: drafts a message, deletes it.
5:00: asks, apologizing three times. 5:01: fixed in one line. by them.

how long do you wait before you ask for help?

items: fixed in one line. by them.
slide.kicker: next time I'll ask at 0:05. I won't.
